query_text: Imagine that instead of presidential debates, we had rap battles. Write a script for how one of the Hillary vs Trump debates in 2016 would have looked like.

content.text:
I'd be happy to write a fun, creative political satire script! Note that this is purely fictional and comedic — the "raps" are based on well-known public policy positions, campaign slogans, and famous moments from the actual 2016 debates. Let's have some fun! 🎤

---

# 🎤 THE 2016 PRESIDENTIAL RAP BATTLE 🎤
### *Moderated by Lester Holt*
*Location: Hofstra University. The stage has two podiums replaced by two **mic stands**. A DJ booth sits center stage. The crowd goes WILD.*

---

**LESTER HOLT:** *(adjusting headphones)*
Good evening, America. I'm your moderator and tonight's DJ, Lester Holt. The rules are simple — spit your bars, keep it (mostly) clean, and please... no interrupting. I'm looking at YOU, Mr. Trump.

*crowd laughs*

The topic for Round 1: **The Economy.** Secretary Clinton, you drop first.

---

### 🔵 ROUND 1 — THE ECONOMY

**HILLARY:** *(steps up, smooths pantsuit, takes mic)*

I've been in this game since you were cutting deals,
While you were going bankrupt, I was closing real bills.
Four times you filed — couldn't run a casino?
How you gonna run a country, Mr. Trumpolino?
I've got a plan for jobs, for the middle class rise,
You've got a hat and a slogan — that's your whole enterprise.
*Stronger Together* — yeah, that's what I preach,
While your trickle-down economics stays out of reach!

*crowd reacts — some cheers, some boos*

---

**TRUMP:** *(storms up, points finger at crowd)*

Believe me, folks — she's been there THIRTY years,
What has she done? Nothing but causing fears!
I build buildings, I build brands, I build 'em tall,
She couldn't even handle her emails — SAD, y'all!
I'll bring back the jobs from China and Mexico too,
While Crooked Hillary's been sleeping — what else is new?
My tax plan is HUGE, it's the best, it's terrific,
Her policies? Boring. Mine? Magnificent, prolific!

*TRUMP drops the mic — picks it back up immediately*

---

**LESTER HOLT:** ...Please don't drop the mic, Mr. Trump, those are rented.

---

### 🔵 ROUND 2 — FOREIGN POLICY

**LESTER HOLT:** Round 2. Foreign Policy. Mr. Trump, you go first.

**TRUMP:** *(beatboxes briefly, stops, looks confused at his own hands)*

I know more about ISIS than the generals, it's true,
I'll bomb 'em so fast their heads'll spin — wouldn't you?
NATO's a rip-off, they don't pay their fair share,
But I get along with Putin — we've got great hair!
I'll build a wall — and Mexico's picking up the check,
And if they say no? I'll tweet 'em to heck!
My foreign policy's simple: America First,
While Hillary's deleted emails are the WORST!

---

**HILLARY:** *(calmly takes a sip of water, smiles)*

I've met with world leaders in over a hundred nations,
You've met with foreign dignitaries at golf course locations.
I helped get Bin Laden — I was in that room,
You were hosting *The Apprentice* — "You're fired," goes the boom.
You called Miss Universe *Miss Housekeeping* — really?
I'm talking nuclear codes and you're acting so silly.
*I'm with Her* — and "Her" has the resume,
While you can't name a country that starts with a K!

*crowd ERUPTS*

---

### 🔵 ROUND 3 — THE PERSONAL ROUND *(things get spicy)*

**LESTER HOLT:** And now... the personal round. God help us all.

**TRUMP:** *(circling the stage like a shark)*

She's got no stamina — look at her, low energy!
I've got buildings, a jet, and unlimited synergy!
Your husband Bill — let's talk about that,
While you're calling MY supporters deplorable — WHAT?
I've built an empire from a *small* loan, it's true—
*(crowd murmurs)*
...Okay a *medium* loan — but I still outgrew you!
When I'm in the White House, it'll be so great,
You'll be in jail — we'll *Lock Her Up* — can't wait!

---

**HILLARY:** *(pauses, does the infamous **shoulder shimmy**)*

Oh Donald... bless your heart, where do I start?
You owe money to banks in every continent's chart.
You said you're smart 'cause you don't pay your taxes —
I said that proves my point — your logic just crashes!
Your own party can't stand ya, Republicans flee,
While I've got Obama, Michelle, and Beyoncé with me!
You say you'll be presidential — we're still waiting, hon,
The bar is on the floor and you're STILL coming undone!

*MIC DROP* 🎤💥

---

### 🏆 FINAL VERDICT

**LESTER HOLT:** *(sighing deeply)*
Well, America... you've seen the battle. You make the call in November. I need a vacation.

*Both candidates argue over who won as the DJ plays "Started From the Bottom" and then "Fight Song" simultaneously, creating audio chaos.*

**THE END.**

---
*Disclaimer: This is a work of political satire and comedy. All "lyrics" are fictional and based on publicly known debate moments and campaign rhetoric. No actual rap careers were harmed in the making of this script.* 😄
